source_dependency_notes: Geometric maps are defined using AU before invoking RT comparison.
BHMV colored splitting is used only to prove the reverse-handle scalar D and identify the independently defined expression with the RT state.
General modular-functor-to-TQFT uniqueness is not assumed without normalization choices.
Funar 1995 was inspected as contextual reconstruction literature but is not a proof dependency because its anomaly-free scope would need adaptation.
Grove 2001 institutional abstract was inspected as context but full text was not verified and no theorem from it is required.
publication_scope: Only authored reports and public-source bibliographic/verification metadata; no copied third-party source documents or text.
